title: Writing Task 2: Task Response and Position
verifiableTask: Elaborar plano de ensaio com posição inequívoca

content.text: o que o enunciado pede, com uma
do início ao fim. Muitos ensaios perdem nota por fugir do tema ou responder só metade da pergunta.
Ao final da aula você consegue:
identificar o tipo de enunciado, o tema exato e escrever uma tese clara + plano.
elaborar plano de ensaio com posição inequívoca.
Responda com posição clara em 1 frase:
Is social media good for teenagers?
Should cars be banned from city centres?
→ I partly agree / social media can help teenagers / it connects them, but it can also harm their sleep → I disagree / cars should be banned / many workers depend on them

Tipos de enunciado (e o que cada um pede)
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
What are the causes/problems… and what solutions can you suggest?
Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
Why is this happening? Is it a positive or negative development?
I completely agree that… · I partly agree… · I firmly disagree with the view that… · In my opinion, the advantages clearly outweigh… · This essay will argue that…
Palavras do enunciado que limitam o tema
young people · in developed countries · in the workplace · governments · individuals · only · always · should
To a large extent, I agree that governments should invest more in public transport.

o tema + as palavras que limitam (
o tipo de enunciado e o que ele exige.
(2 parágrafos de corpo com 1 ideia central cada).
(1–2 frases): retome a tese com outras palavras.
Some people believe that the best way to reduce traffic in cities is to make public transport free. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
While free public transport would help to reduce congestion, I do not believe it is the best solution on its own; it must be combined with better services and limits on car use.
Body 1 — free transport helps (cost barrier, e.g., Tallinn) · Body 2 — not enough alone (quality, coverage, car habits) → needs other measures

4.2 Identifique o tipo e o que falta
Many people move to cities for work. What problems does this cause, and what can be done?
Some say that sport at school is a waste of time. Others think it is essential. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
More people are working from home. Is this a positive or negative development?
Tourism brings money but also damages the environment. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
There are many different opinions about this topic.
I firmly believe that the benefits of tourism outweigh its environmental costs, provided that governments regulate it.
